sources.title: aoiandroid/Breeze-ASR-25_coreml · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Breeze-ASR-25 is a high-performance automatic speech recognition model developed by MediaTek Research. This CoreML version enables on-device inference on Apple Silicon devices through Whisperkit integration.

sources.title: Breeze ASR 25 - GitHub
sources.snippet: Breeze ASR 25 is an advanced ASR model fine-tuned from Whisper-large-v2 Optimized for Taiwanese Mandarin Adopted an unified mix embedding for decoding, optimized for Mandarin-English code-switching scenarios, including intra-sentential switching and inter-sentential switching. Enhanced time alignment, suitable for automatic captioning

sources.title: Installation | mtkresearch/Breeze-ASR-25 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The installation process sets up the necessary environment for both programmatic integration through the HuggingFace pipeline and command-line usage through the enhanced Whisper CLI interface. Once installed, the system provides access to the specialized Breeze ASR 25 model optimized for Traditional Chinese and code-switching scenarios.
